column2: OASIS: Open Agent Social Interaction Simulations with One Million Agents (Simulating Safety Risks of Misinformation Spread)
column6: Fetched (arXiv HTML v4). Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory is the primary/first-listed affiliation (in-scope named evaluator), co-authored with Dalian UT, Oxford, KAUST, Fudan, etc. Qualifying methodology/tooling finding (1.0 cat 2: a scalable million-agent social-simulation framework) plus evidence-backed empirical findings using named LLM agents (Llama3-8b-instruct primary; Qwen1.5-7B-Chat, InternLM2-chat-20b ablations): rumors reach significantly broader than truthful info, opinions polarize toward extremity over time, and agents show stronger-than-human herd conformity that intensifies with scale. Pre-cutoff (2024-11-18). No existing report_id maps -> candidate miss.
